column2: Replaced hardcoded `passed: true` with a network-blocking wrapper around `GithubTarget.compile`/`GitlabTarget.compile`; the check now fails if the network is touched or diagnostics are emitted.
Removed the tautology. The §34.3 check now calls `target.compile()`, validates that artifacts were produced, that the YAML contains the expected marker, and that no diagnostics were emitted.
Engine execution now uses `os.tmpdir()` and `fs.mkdtemp` for the workspace, and cleans up with `rm(..., { recursive: true })` in a `finally` block.
Test workspaces now use `os.tmpdir()`/`mkdtemp` with per-test `beforeEach`/`afterEach` cleanup instead of hardcoded `/tmp` paths.

Seed pipeline now declares scalar and artifact outputs (`lint.status`, `build.dist`), value/artifact inputs on dependent steps, and a context condition on `test`.
`runConformance` is now composed of focused per-criterion helper functions (`checkAuthoring`, `checkGraphEquivalence`, `checkEngineExecution`, `checkScalarFlow`, etc.).
Extracted shared inputs, commands, references, and outputs into module-level constants and reused them across the Construct, SDK, and Decorator seeds.
Serialization round-trip now canonicalizes the full graph (sorted object keys and arrays) and compares the entire structure, not just the project ID.

`makeDriver` now uses `createAllowlist(["sh"])` so the seed shell scripts are allowed to execute.
The acceptance-criteria coverage test now asserts the presence of §34.1–§34.11 and the serialization round-trip result by name prefix.

Implemented a dedicated cycle-detection check that creates a cyclic `Project`/`Pipeline`, calls `synthesize`, and asserts a `SynthesisError` with code `CYCLE`.
